meta.inspection: All 25 images individually inspected using view_image. No source, key or other judges read. Exact prior anchors retained using own prior image hashes.
meta.blinding_limitations: Repeated controls and visual families recognizable. Sci-fi resembles StarCraft; battlefields Company of Heroes; tactical reference uncertain.

view-01.png.evidence: Crisp plane outline, dimensional rocks and tree crowns; varied ocean adds surface depth.
view-01.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Fine water texture contrasts with simple beach and flat grass. Coast still looks a cut edge with an abrupt stepped color transition at top.

view-02.png.evidence: Cyan circle makes player easy to locate beside rocks; shaded trees and dark ocean retain depth.
view-02.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Coast now has broad uniform cyan glow that reads as illumination rather than irregular surf. Abrupt segmented beach transition remains; flat grass and heavy tree contacts persist.

view-03.png.evidence: Cyan circle isolates player location on pale carrier bow; restored narrow hull rim reads continuously.
view-03.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Ring locates plane without improving aircraft material contrast. Deck shading remains uniform, ocean busy and wake repeated puffs.

view-04.png.evidence: Sparse composition, dark hull edge, readable raised island and light player silhouette on sea.
view-04.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player overlaps tan deck at bow; repetitive segmented wake and soft carrier edges. Dark detailed ocean lacks corresponding deck lighting complexity.

view-05.png.evidence: Dark ocean separates pale planes; deck panels, raised island and shaded hull give depth. Tiny orange impact flares read.
view-05.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Planes on tan deck overlap markings; repeated wake puffs and broad shadows remain. High-frequency water competes with small sprites.

view-06.png.evidence: Cyan player circle provides a focal location amid pale overlapping aircraft; dark hull and sea remain legible.
view-06.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Ring cannot separate overlapping aircraft within it. Equal orange impacts and smoke stamps still fragment attention; soft edges limit definition.

view-07.png.evidence: Wet reflections, rain, tracer and smoke unify rich rubble/mud.
view-07.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Dark units merge with terrain. Unchanged reference.

view-08.png.evidence: Cyan circle finds player above matching blue roof; apron, lanes and runway remain clearly structured.
view-08.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Aircraft body still blends into hangar. New shore glow is continuous bright cyan rather than convincing foam or shallow-water structure; segmented beach edge persists.

view-09.png.evidence: Crisp cyan circle identifies player on carrier bow; raised island and exposed continuous hull rim give depth.
view-09.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Extra ring is a readable overlay, not increased material richness. Uniform deck lighting, busy ocean and segmented wake remain.

view-10.png.evidence: Cyan circle clearly locates aircraft over grass/rocks; soft coast scene remains readable.
view-10.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Broad glowing shoreline lacks irregular surf structure and emphasizes artificial edge. Grass flat and trees carry heavy repeated contact shadows.

view-11.png.evidence: Player ring helps locate bow aircraft among sparse opponents; impacts and hull remain clear.
view-11.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Aircraft within circle still merges into pale deck markings. Soft edges, puff wake and fine busy water remain.

view-12.png.evidence: Cyan ring adds focal location to sparse combat; crisp planes and small orange hits read against dark water.
view-12.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Overlapping planes and runway marks inside ring remain ambiguous. Repeated smoke and wake stamps lack organic variation.

view-13.png.evidence: Layered fog, trees, tracks and damaged buildings give rich depth.
view-13.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Units merge with ground/haze. Unchanged reference.

view-14.png.evidence: Dark water frames light carrier and planes; large controls and compact orange flares remain readable.
view-14.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Soft aircraft edges merge into deck marks. Water is busier than quieter retained controls; wake has repeated oval segments.

view-15.png.evidence: Warm shadowed market with produce/props and traceable colored routes.
view-15.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Small brown figures merge into surroundings. Unchanged reference.

view-16.png.evidence: Distinct floors, wall depth, warm/cool light and furniture contacts.
view-16.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Tiny units/text demanding at phone size. Unchanged reference.

view-17.png.evidence: Dark water provides background contrast to pale aircraft and orange impacts; deck remains traceable.
view-17.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Numerous equal fire specks, smoke dots and overlapping planes obscure priorities; lower-resolution edges reduce separation on deck.

view-18.png.evidence: Player circle gives a clearer location amid dense aircraft; dark hull and detailed sea preserve depth.
view-18.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Circle encompasses overlapping planes rather than separating them. Numerous equal orange effects and smoke rosettes remain distracting; HUD-plane overlap at top persists.

view-19.png.evidence: Aircraft outline remains visible beside rocks; shaded trees and varied dark water add depth.
view-19.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Beach is abrupt narrow strip with segmented upper transitions; flat ground and heavy circular tree contacts contrast with detailed sea. Soft edges limit precision.

view-20.png.evidence: Broad apron, service lanes and raised blue roofs establish functional base; dark blue ocean adds material depth.
view-20.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Blue player still merges with blue hangar. Noisy grass, abrupt shore segments and strong tree contacts remain; water realism exceeds polygonal land style.

view-21.png.evidence: Pale plane silhouettes contrast against dark textured sea; orange impacts and thin smoke have defined forms.
view-21.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Many equal orange flecks and crossing planes fragment attention. Player near bow remains crowded; smoke rosettes and repeated wake puffs look stamped.

view-22.png.evidence: Ring helps locate player over middle blue hangar; service apron and runway give clear base organization.
view-22.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Soft aircraft still merges with roof. Broad cyan shore band looks emissive; coarse grass and strong tree shadows remain stylistically mismatched with sea.

view-23.png.evidence: Service apron and roads structure base; dark sea provides a clear coastline boundary.
view-23.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player nearly merges with middle blue hangar; grass uniform, tree shadows heavy, coastline sharply segmented. Fallback softness reduces material separation.

view-24.png.evidence: Metal ships and cool rock contrast with layered bright explosion.
view-24.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Blast obscures units; purple forms merge with foliage. Unchanged reference.

view-25.png.evidence: Raised island, deck seams and dark hull establish carrier volume against deeper-looking ocean.
view-25.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Player partly merges with runway marks; wake remains repeated puffs and sea fine texture competes with more schematic vessel shading.

general_next_priorities: Keep useful player-location cue but improve aircraft material separation over roofs and deck.
Replace uniform glowing coastline with varied shallow-water width and irregular low-contrast surf tied to shoreline.
Differentiate significant impacts from background sparks and reduce overlap interference in dense scenes.
Maintain coherent hull rim and sidewalls; improve deck lighting and replace repeated wake/smoke stamps.
